Dionne has been a Senior Lecturer of Business Administration at the Harvard Business School since 2014 and serves on the boards of Bridgepoint Group, Cengage Learning, and Clear Channel Outdoors, and as a Senior Advisor to BayPine and Privacore Capital. He currently teaches “Private Equity Projects and Ecosystems,” a highly rated elective course that pairs students with leading private equity firms on value-added projects, as well an extensive lecture series on the private equity ecosystem.
